name: print-social-gym-fitness-posts-grey-with-red-circles-and-cutouts
title: 'Shape Your Body' gym pack on grey with red circles and athletic cut-outs
whatItIs: Five square posts on light grey with cut-out photos of a woman in black and red activewear with dumbbells and headphones, large red circles behind, bold white 'SHAPE YOUR BODY TODAY' type, black '20% off' circle badges and a phone number.
whatItMeans: Strong and motivational; the red circle feels like a spotlight on effort.
techniques: Place a cut-out athlete over a big colour circle.
Match the circle to the outfit colour.
Stamp discounts on a dark circle badge.

vocabulary.definition: A large circle behind a subject to focus attention.
A small shape containing an offer.
